thread:
mina: Hi folks, first week q where's the single source for onboarding templates? I want to copy a runbook and a 1:1 agenda but Duplicate is greyed out for me.
devex-bot: Quick checks: are you in the Redwood workspace, and is the page a DB template or locked? If "Can view" only, request edit or ask the page owner.
mina: I'm in the workspace. On desktop the three-dot menu shows but Duplicate is disabled and I don't see an Owner field.
oly: Welcome Mina! If it's part of a database you won't duplicate the master page open the DB -> New -> pick the template. If it's a locked master copy, owners lock it to avoid edits.
people-ops: Our canonical templates live in People Ops > Templates (1:1, onboarding) and Company Home > Templates (runbooks/playbooks). If Duplicate is disabled ping us or the owner link and we'll adjust permissions.
sam: If you need the runbook for oncall, create from the Runbooks DB and then move the new page into Company Home > Eng > eng-runbooks so oncall can find it.
mina: Cool. How do I tell who owns a doc for future edits?
ken: Two ways: 1) Hover near the title for the Owner property on managed pages. 2) We ask teams to add a tiny header block with: Owner, Last updated, How to duplicate. If Owner is missing, ping the team channel and add a one-line doc-meta yourself.
people-ops: Also we keep a lightweight registry at Company Home > Docs Registry for critical runbooks and owners. If you can't find the owner, drop the page link here and we'll assign one.
mina: Thanks! I refreshed after permissions change and Duplicate appeared. I'll move the copies to eng-runbooks and My Workspace and add doc-meta. Appreciate the quick help :tada:
oly: Welcome aboard Mina! Ping #devex if anything else blocks you.
